name: Cache Register
project_description: Cache Register aims to improve the developer experience of caching arbitrary data. It provides simple Drawer, Slot, and Register objects that enforce best-practice naming of associated cache entries and provide assorted helper methods for interacting with those cache entries. A Drawer groups related cache entries under a shared prefix and cache tag; a Slot is an accessor for one specific cache entry (cid) within a Drawer; a Register is an optional special Slot whose cache entry tracks the IDs of all Slots opened on a Drawer. The module has no UI, routes, permissions, or configuration -- it exposes a single service, cache_register.manager, that wraps core's CacheBackendInterface to reduce caching boilerplate and remove the need to hand-manage cid strings.
